text: Everyone has dreams about the future. Some people want a good career, some want to travel, and some want to start a family. To reach your goal, you need a clear plan. First, decide what you really want in life, then think about the steps you need to take. Many people make a resolution at the start of a new year, like learning a new skill or getting a better job. It is normal to face a challenge on your journey to success. When things get difficult, try to stay confident and keep going. You can ask a friend or teacher to motivate you when you feel tired. Every mistake is also an opportunity to improve and learn something new. If you aim high and work hard, you can achieve your goals and succeed in life. It helps to imagine your future clearly: where do you want to be in five years? Having hope for the future gives you energy to keep trying, even when the path is not easy. Your ambition can guide you through hard times. Remember, the future is not fixed; every choice you make today can change your path tomorrow.
